thread:
mina: hey all, first day and hitting a weird state. unboxed the M3 Mac and it went through OOBE, but Kandji shows enrolled = yes while System Settings still shows no profile and FileVault prompt never appeared. also trying to update to Ventura 13.6.1 via Software Update fails with permissions error. homebrew fails too (permission denied). anyone seen partial enroll like this?

harry-it: welcome @mina. partial state suggests post-provisioning scripts didn't finish. can you run `profiles status` and `sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-enroll --status` and paste outputs? also, did you accept the management prompts during first-run? sometimes the profile approval dialog is behind other windows.

mina: `profiles status` -> "MDM: Kandji (managed) but no user profiles". `kandji-enroll --status` -> "Enrolled: True, Last push: pending scripts". i think i saw a dialog earlier but it disappeared.

it-bot: Support ticket RH-4872 opened and auto-assigned to harry-it. link: https://internal.redwood/support/RH-4872

harry-it: ok looks like the MDM cert push completed but some post-enroll Munki/osx-scripts didn't run which handle FileVault enable + permissions for /usr/local. trying a remote run of our agent now. can you keep the laptop plugged in and on company wifi?

mina: on Redwood Onboarding wifi and plugged in.

harry-it: attempted remote run, it failed with error "kext approval required". there may be a system extension stuck waiting for user approval in Security & Privacy. can you open System Settings > Privacy & Security and look for any system software blocked from loading? (there's usually a note at the bottom).

mina: seeing a blocked kernel extension from com.redwood.vmnet and a note to "Allow" from developer "Redwood Labs Inc". clicking allow prompts for admin credentials which i don't have.

devex-nina: Hi @mina, i can approve a one-time sudo grant. submit the devex admin form: https://internal.redwood/devex/admin-request and paste the id. if you'd rather wait, harry can push a signed profile that auto-authorizes the kext but that takes ~10-15 mins.

mei: if this blocks dev work it might be worth the short admin window. up to you. also tagging this for onboarding doc updates.

mina: submitted admin request ADM-9110

harry-it: while we wait, i'm going to re-run the post-enroll scripts from console side; might still fail until kext is allowed.

devex-nina: ADM-9110 approved for 45 minutes. once you get sudo, please run `sudo /usr/local/bin/run-post-enroll` and then try Software Update again. i'll monitor and revoke early if not used.

mina: ran `sudo /usr/local/bin/run-post-enroll` after granting sudo. output: "FileVault: enabled, escrowed to Kandji; /usr/local perms fixed; kext clearance pending user approval"

mina: went to Privacy & Security and clicked Allow, then restarted. after reboot, Software Update to 13.6.1 succeeded, homebrew install works and FileVault shows as enabled in System Settings. :tada:

harry-it: thanks for being patient. closing RH-4872. we'll add a step to the imaging checklist to pre-sign our network kexts and to surface the Privacy & Security allow step during OOBE.

devex-nina: revoking ADM-9110 now since it was used. note for devex: prefer signed profile push when possible to avoid granting admin on day 0.

mina: huge thanks everyone. logging these notes into the onboarding checklist so future new hires don't hit the same thing. happy to pair on the doc if useful.

harry-it: welcome to Redwood, @mina! ping IT if anything else pops up.
